questions.q: What is the final job structure for this chapter's full medallion pipeline?
options: Three tasks — bronze_ingest, silver_clean, gold_aggregate — each depending on the one before it
A single task that does everything in one giant script
Two separate, unrelated jobs with no task dependencies
Five tasks, one per medallion layer plus two extra for quarantine
questions.explain: This reuses Lesson 11's task-chaining, guaranteeing correct read order at every stage.

questions.q: What does Task 1 (bronze_ingest) do in this pipeline?
options: Continuously ingests new files via Autoloader, keeping every row including malformed ones
Aggregates data into gold-level business metrics
Deduplicates and casts columns to their correct types
Grants Unity Catalog permissions to new users
questions.explain: This is Lesson 32's Autoloader pattern, combined with Lesson 26's bronze design principle of keeping everything.

questions.q: What does Task 2 (silver_clean) incorporate, beyond just casting and deduplication?
options: A 3-day lookback window for late-arriving data correction, plus quarantining bad rows and tracking quality metrics
Only the basic casting logic, with nothing else
Direct writes to gold, skipping silver entirely
Unity Catalog access control grants
questions.explain: This incorporates Lessons 35 and 36's late-data correction and quality tracking as real, necessary parts of the pipeline.

questions.q: What is still missing from this pipeline that Chapter 4 (Unity Catalog) will add?
options: Real access control governing who can query bronze/silver/gold tables, plus lineage tracking through the pipeline
The ability to write any data to a Delta table at all
Schema enforcement, which hasn't been covered yet
The ability to schedule a job on a recurring basis
questions.explain: Right now, anyone with workspace access can query these tables directly — Chapter 4 is exactly that missing governance layer.

questions.q: When tracing one NYC Taxi record through the pipeline, what happens to it in bronze specifically?
options: It lands in bronze.trips untouched, with an _ingested_at timestamp recorded, before any cleaning happens
It's immediately cast to its correct type and deduplicated
It's aggregated into that day's revenue total
It's checked against Unity Catalog permissions before being stored
questions.explain: This is exactly Lesson 26's bronze design — minimal transformation, metadata columns, nothing filtered yet.
